```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source(here::here("scripts", "00_functions.R"))
setup_run()
```

# Overview

Import raw BHAMM data, apply inclusion/exclusion criteria, collate blood
measures across sessions, impute missing SBP and total cholesterol with
missForest, drop the sample-level exclusions (`params$sample_excl`) and export
the MATLAB B-PLS inputs.

**Outputs**

- `data/processed/bhamm_clean.{rds,csv}` — analytic sample (N = 82)
- `data/matlab_io/input/<segment>/pls_export.csv` + `matlab_group_ids.txt` (every registered run)
- `outputs/qc/script1_start_ids.csv`, `script1_final_ids.csv`, `exclusion_log.csv`, `rsfmri_qc_exclusions.csv`, `sample_exclusions.csv` — Figure 1 inputs
- `outputs/supplement/FigureS1_imputation.png` — Figure S1

```{r load-packages}
pacman::p_load(here, haven, readxl, janitor, tidyverse, naniar, missForest, fedmatch)
```

# 1. Import & initial filtering

```{r import-raw}
bhamm_df <- haven::read_sav(here::here("data", "raw", params$raw_master_file)) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  # Pre- or post-menopausal at BOTH sessions; females only
  mutate(group_var = factor(case_when(
    sex == 1 & s1_meno_group == 1 & s2_meno_group == 1 ~ "Pre-Meno",
    sex == 1 & s1_meno_group == 3 & s2_meno_group == 3 ~ "Post-Meno",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ), levels = c("Pre-Meno", "Post-Meno"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(s1_date), !is.na(s2_date),       # attended both sessions
         !is.na(group_var),
         s2_age >= 39.5 & s2_age < 65.5)          # aged 40-65 (rounded)

start_ids <- bhamm_df %>% select(id, group_var) %>% arrange(group_var, id)
cat("Starting N (before health exclusions):", nrow(start_ids), "\n")
print(table(start_ids$group_var))
```

# 2. Health exclusions

```{r health-exclusions}
exclusion_criteria <- list(
  HRT                       = function(df) filter(df, hrt_use == 2),
  hysterectomy_oophorectomy = function(df) filter(df, straw_issues_notes ==
                                                    "Hysterectomy, Unilateral oophorectomy"),
  # Post-meno: any HBC use. Pre-meno: HBC for non-contraceptive purposes only.
  HBC                       = function(df) filter(df,
    (group_var == "Post-Meno" & current_hbc_med_use == -1) |
    (group_var == "Pre-Meno"  & current_hbc_med_use == -1 &
       current_hbc_med_use_contraception == 1)),
  BMI_over_40               = function(df) filter(df, bmi > 40)
)

exclusion_log <- imap_dfr(exclusion_criteria, function(fn, name) {
  fn(bhamm_df) %>% mutate(reason = name) %>% select(id, group_var, reason)
}) %>%
  group_by(id, group_var) %>%
  summarise(reason = paste(unique(reason), collapse = " & "), .groups = "drop")

print(exclusion_log)
write_csv(exclusion_log, shared_output_path("qc", "exclusion_log.csv"))

bhamm_df_clean <- bhamm_df %>% filter(!id %in% exclusion_log$id)
cat("After health exclusions:", nrow(bhamm_df_clean), "\n")
print(table(bhamm_df_clean$group_var))
```

# 3. rsfMRI quality control

```{r rsfmri-qc}
rsfc_qc <- read_excel(here::here("data", "raw", params$rsfmri_qc_file)) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  filter(id %in% bhamm_df_clean$id) %>%
  mutate(final_rating_pass_fail = fedmatch::clean_strings(final_rating_pass_fail),
         rater_2                = fedmatch::clean_strings(rater_2))

qc_failed <- rsfc_qc %>%
  filter(final_rating_pass_fail == "fail" | (!is.na(rater_2) & rater_2 == "fail")) %>%
  transmute(id = as.character(id), reason = "Failed visual QC / excessive motion")

# Manual removals with documented reasons (params$rsfmri_manual_excl, from the
# private participant-exclusions file). IDs no longer in the sample at this
# point remove no one.
qc_manual <- tibble(
  id     = vapply(params$rsfmri_manual_excl, function(e) as.character(e$id), character(1)),
  reason = vapply(params$rsfmri_manual_excl, function(e) as.character(e$reason), character(1))
)

rsfmri_excl <- bind_rows(qc_manual, qc_failed %>% filter(!id %in% qc_manual$id)) %>%
  inner_join(bhamm_df_clean %>% transmute(id = as.character(id), group_var), by = "id")
print(rsfmri_excl)
write_csv(rsfmri_excl, shared_output_path("qc", "rsfmri_qc_exclusions.csv"))

bhamm_df_clean2 <- bhamm_df_clean %>% filter(!as.character(id) %in% rsfmri_excl$id)
cat("After rsfMRI QC:", nrow(bhamm_df_clean2), "\n")
print(table(bhamm_df_clean2$group_var))
```

# 4. Select & recode variables

```{r select-columns}
demo_cols <- c(
  "id", "s2_age", "group_var",
  "meds_antidepressant_uk", "meds_ssr_is", "meds_sar_is", "meds_snr_is",
  "meds_tc_as", "meds_bzd", "meds_nbzd",
  "meds_statin", "meds_cholestrol_lowering",
  "enrol_meds_ace_inhibitor", "enrol_meds_ar_bs", "enrol_meds_ccb",
  "enrol_meds_diuretic", "enrol_meds_alpha_blockers",
  "bdi", "current_hbc_med_use", "repro_cond_pcos", "apoe4_allele"
)

mem_task_cols <- c(params$cs_vars, params$cr_vars)

blood_cols <- c(
  "chol_raw_s1", "chol_raw_s2", "hdl_raw_s1", "hdl_raw_s2",
  "ldl_raw_s1", "ldl_raw_s2", "apo_a1_raw_s1", "apo_a1_raw_s2",
  "apo_b_raw_s1", "apo_b_raw_s2", "h_crp_raw_s1", "h_crp_raw_s2",
  "non_hdl_chol_raw_s1", "non_hdl_chol_raw_s2", "trig_raw_s1", "trig_raw_s2",
  "fsh_raw_s1", "fsh_raw_s2", "e2_raw_s1", "e2_raw_s2",
  "lh_raw_s1", "lh_raw_s2", "prog_raw_s1", "prog_raw_s2",
  "testo_raw_s1", "testo_raw_s2",
  "bp_systolic_s1", "bp_systolic_s2", "bp_diastolic_s1", "bp_diastolic_s2",
  "bmi", "edu", "ipaq_va_day", "ipaq_va_min"
)

extra_cols <- params$extra_cleaning_cols

cleaned_df <- bhamm_df_clean2 %>%
  select(any_of(c(demo_cols, mem_task_cols, blood_cols, extra_cols))) %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(blood_cols), as.numeric),
         across(any_of(extra_cols), ~ as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(.x))))

missing_cols <- setdiff(c(demo_cols, mem_task_cols, blood_cols, extra_cols), names(cleaned_df))
if (length(missing_cols)) stop("Columns not found in raw data: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r recode-categorical}
# SPSS coding for yes/no items: -1 = Yes, 1 = No
yes_no <- function(x) factor(case_when(x == -1 ~ "Yes", x == 1 ~ "No"), levels = c("Yes", "No"))
any_yes <- function(df, cols) {
  factor(if_else(rowSums(across(all_of(cols), ~ . == -1), na.rm = TRUE) > 0, "Yes", "No"),
         levels = c("Yes", "No"))
}

cleaned_df <- cleaned_df %>%
  mutate(
    current_hbc_med_use  = yes_no(current_hbc_med_use),
    repro_cond_pcos      = yes_no(repro_cond_pcos),
    any_psychotropic     = any_yes(., c("meds_antidepressant_uk", "meds_ssr_is", "meds_sar_is",
                                        "meds_snr_is", "meds_tc_as", "meds_bzd", "meds_nbzd")),
    any_chol_med         = any_yes(., c("meds_statin", "meds_cholestrol_lowering")),
    any_antihypertensive = any_yes(., c("enrol_meds_ace_inhibitor", "enrol_meds_ar_bs",
                                        "enrol_meds_ccb", "enrol_meds_diuretic",
                                        "enrol_meds_alpha_blockers")),
    apoe4_carrier        = factor(case_when(apoe4_allele == -1 ~ "Carrier",
                                            apoe4_allele ==  1 ~ "Non-Carrier")),
    bai                  = bai_somatic + bai_subjective   # BAI total = sum of subscales
  )

for (v in c("current_hbc_med_use", "repro_cond_pcos", "any_psychotropic",
            "any_chol_med", "any_antihypertensive", "apoe4_carrier")) {
  cat("\n", v, "\n"); print(table(cleaned_df[[v]], cleaned_df$group_var, useNA = "ifany"))
}
```

# 5. Collate S1/S2 blood measures

```{r combine-sessions}
# Blood/BP: S1 primary, S2 fallback. Hormones: S2 primary (closer to scan), S1 fallback.
vars_blood_collated <- cleaned_df %>%
  transmute(
    id, group_var,
    e2_raw           = coalesce(e2_raw_s2,  e2_raw_s1),
    fsh_raw          = coalesce(fsh_raw_s2, fsh_raw_s1),
    chol_raw         = coalesce(chol_raw_s1,         chol_raw_s2),
    hdl_raw          = coalesce(hdl_raw_s1,          hdl_raw_s2),
    ldl_raw          = coalesce(ldl_raw_s1,          ldl_raw_s2),
    apo_a1_raw       = coalesce(apo_a1_raw_s1,       apo_a1_raw_s2),
    apo_b_raw        = coalesce(apo_b_raw_s1,        apo_b_raw_s2),
    h_crp_raw        = coalesce(h_crp_raw_s1,        h_crp_raw_s2),
    trig_raw         = coalesce(trig_raw_s1,         trig_raw_s2),
    non_hdl_chol_raw = coalesce(non_hdl_chol_raw_s1, non_hdl_chol_raw_s2),
    bp_systolic      = coalesce(bp_systolic_s1,      bp_systolic_s2),
    bp_diastolic     = coalesce(bp_diastolic_s1,     bp_diastolic_s2),
    bmi
  )
blood_vars_final <- setdiff(names(vars_blood_collated), c("id", "group_var"))

# missForest inputs: all collated blood measures except the hormones and
# diastolic BP. SBP and total cholesterol are the only PLS variables with
# missing values; the other lipids and BMI act as auxiliary predictors.
blood_vars_for_imputation <- setdiff(blood_vars_final, c("e2_raw", "fsh_raw", "bp_diastolic"))

# Non-detects (-1) -> NA for the imputation variables
vars_blood_collated <- vars_blood_collated %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(blood_vars_for_imputation), ~ na_if(.x, -1)))

cleaned_df2 <- cleaned_df %>%
  select(-bmi) %>%
  left_join(vars_blood_collated %>% select(id, all_of(blood_vars_final)), by = "id")
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(cleaned_df2$id)))
```

# 6. Imputation (missForest)

```{r impute-missforest}
# Participant id and group are passed to missForest as predictors, as in the
# submitted analysis. Changing the input set changes the imputed values and
# would require re-running every B-PLS in MATLAB.
impute_df <- cleaned_df2 %>%
  select(id, group_var, all_of(blood_vars_for_imputation)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

impute_df %>%
  group_by(group_var) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), missing_TC = sum(is.na(chol_raw)), missing_SBP = sum(is.na(bp_systolic))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = sprintf("Missing values before imputation (imputation sample, N = %d)",
                                 nrow(impute_df)))

set.seed(params$seed_imputation)
missforest_out <- missForest(impute_df)
cat("missForest OOB error:\n"); print(missforest_out$OOBerror)

imputed <- missforest_out$ximp %>%
  select(id, all_of(blood_vars_for_imputation)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_imputed"), all_of(blood_vars_for_imputation))

cleaned_df3 <- cleaned_df2 %>% left_join(imputed, by = "id")
```

# 7. Derived variables

```{r derived-vars}
cleaned_df3 <- cleaned_df3 %>%
  mutate(
    # Physical activity: -1 = Active (>= min_days vigorous days/wk of >= min_minutes),
    # 1 = Inactive (including missing IPAQ)
    Exercise_coded = case_when(
      ipaq_va_day >= params$exercise$min_days &
        ipaq_va_min >= params$exercise$min_minutes ~ -1L,
      TRUE ~ 1L),
    # Other hormones (PCOS MANOVA only): S2 primary, S1 fallback
    lh_raw    = coalesce(lh_raw_s2,    lh_raw_s1),
    prog_raw  = coalesce(prog_raw_s2,  prog_raw_s1),
    testo_raw = coalesce(testo_raw_s2, testo_raw_s1)
  )
print(table(cleaned_df3$Exercise_coded, cleaned_df3$group_var, useNA = "ifany"))
```

# 8. Sample-level exclusions & final sample

```{r final-sample}
# Imputation above used the full sample; params$sample_excl are dropped here.
sample_excl <- sample_exclusions()
stopifnot("sample_excl ID not found in the data" = all(sample_excl$id %in% cleaned_df3$id))

sample_excl_log <- sample_excl %>%
  left_join(cleaned_df3 %>% select(id, group_var), by = "id")
print(sample_excl_log)
write_csv(sample_excl_log, shared_output_path("qc", "sample_exclusions.csv"))

bhamm_final <- cleaned_df3 %>%
  filter(!id %in% sample_excl$id) %>%
  arrange(group_var, id)                 # canonical MATLAB row order

cat("Final N:", nrow(bhamm_final), "\n")
print(table(bhamm_final$group_var))

bhamm_final %>%
  group_by(group_var) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), imputed_TC = sum(is.na(chol_raw)), imputed_SBP = sum(is.na(bp_systolic))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Imputed values in the final sample (Methods 2.9.1)")
```

# 9. Figure S1 — observed vs imputed

```{r figS1, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
figS1_df <- bhamm_final %>%
  select(id, group_var, chol_raw, bp_systolic, chol_raw_imputed, bp_systolic_imputed) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(chol_raw_imputed, bp_systolic_imputed),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(imputed = if_else(variable == "chol_raw_imputed", is.na(chol_raw), is.na(bp_systolic)),
         variable = factor(variable, levels = c("bp_systolic_imputed", "chol_raw_imputed"),
                           labels = c("Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)", "Total Cholesterol (mmol/L)")))

p_figS1 <- ggplot(figS1_df, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_density(data = filter(figS1_df, !imputed),
               aes(linetype = "Observed"), linewidth = 0.9, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_density(aes(linetype = "Observed + imputed"), linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#2a7fba") +
  geom_rug(data = filter(figS1_df, imputed), aes(colour = group_var),
           linewidth = 1, length = grid::unit(0.06, "npc")) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Observed" = "solid", "Observed + imputed" = "dashed"),
                        name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, name = "Imputed value") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Density",
       title = "Observed and missForest-imputed values",
       subtitle = sprintf(paste0("N = %d. Imputed values (rug): total cholesterol = %d, ",
                                 "systolic BP = %d. Imputation was run on N = %d before ",
                                 "the sample-level exclusion."),
                          nrow(bhamm_final), sum(is.na(bhamm_final$chol_raw)),
                          sum(is.na(bhamm_final$bp_systolic)), nrow(impute_df))) +
  theme_apa(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))

print(p_figS1)
save_png(p_figS1, supp_path("FigureS1_imputation.png"), width = 10, height = 5)
```

# 10. Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(bhamm_final, cleaning_path("bhamm_clean.rds"))
write.csv(bhamm_final, cleaning_path("bhamm_clean.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write_csv(start_ids, shared_output_path("qc", "script1_start_ids.csv"))
write_csv(bhamm_final %>% select(id, group_var),
          shared_output_path("qc", "script1_final_ids.csv"))

# MATLAB inputs for every registered run (omnibus + reduced-block)
export_all_runs()

save_session_info("script01")
```

**Next step:** run B-PLS in PLSGUI (1000 permutations, 500 bootstraps) on each
`data/matlab_io/input/<segment>/pls_export.csv`, saving the result as
`data/matlab_io/output/<segment>/bpls_result.mat`.
